newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 19.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Thursday:

WASHINGTON - A senior FBI agent was arrested on espionage charges for allegedly serving as a Russian spy, selling vital national security secrets to Russian intelligence agencies and betraying some of the FBI's most sensitive operations.

WASHINGTON - The knock came on a Saturday afternoon. When FBI special agent Earl Edwin Pitts opened the door of his Spotsylvania, Virginia, home, a long-forgotten acquaintance with a thick Russian accent stood before him.

LIMA, Peru - An audacious raid by Marxist guerrillas against the Japanese ambassador's residence settled into a tense and agonising stalemate as terrorists holding up to 400 hostages -- businessmen, government officials and at least 11 foreign ambassadors -- threatened to begin killing them unless their demands were met.

WASHINGTON - A federal judge in Oregon has ruled that expert witnesses who claim a link between silicone breast implants and a wide spectrum of serious immune system diseases should be barred from testifying in lawsuits in his court.

WASHINGTON - The final chapter in the largest and potentially most costly employment discrimination lawsuit ever brought against the U.S. government is being played out in a small courtroom in downtown Washington.

WASHINGTON - A federal judge struck down Clinton Administration restrictions on the export of some forms of data-scrambling software, calling them a violation of free speech rights, according to computer industry officials.
WASHINGTON - A federal jury ordered ABC to pay $10 million to a Florida banker in a libel suit over the network's portrayal of him as misleading investors.
